retrievalProfile.description: A high-contrast double exposure featuring a large profile silhouette containing a backlit concert scene with vibrant neon light bursts.

recipe.visualDefinition: A large, soft-focus profile of a woman's face acts as a frame for a vibrant, high-energy concert scene. The central figure is a backlit performer on stage, surrounded by a crowd of raised hands. Intense light rays in magenta and electric blue emanate from the center, creating a starburst effect that blends the two layers.
coreVisualRelationships: Large profile silhouette containing a smaller full-body performer
Radial light rays originating from the central performer's chest
Contrast between dark peripheral areas and a bright, glowing center
Text layered over the lower third of the composition
coreInvariants: Magenta and electric blue color palette

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Large profile face occupies the left and right edges; small performer centered at the focal point.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The bright white light burst at the center of the performer's silhouette.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes start at the central light burst, move outward along the radial rays to the profile face, then down to the title text.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Deep black in the upper corners and bottom edges provides high contrast for the neon elements.

colorSystem.accentColorRole: Bright White (Core Flare) and Pink (Star Icon)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the light effects against a low-value, dark background.
paletteRestrictions: Limit to cool blues and hot pinks/purples

letterConstructionRules: Varying line weights with visible bristle marks
characterSpecificRedesigns: The 'J' features a long, sweeping tail
A small five-pointed star is integrated above the text
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Expressive, textured script paired with a clean, wide-tracked geometric sans-serif.

candidateDirections.reason: Captures the raw, painterly energy of the main title.
Provides the clean, modern geometric look for the metadata.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a double exposure image with a large female profile in silhouette. Inside the silhouette, place a backlit singer on stage with a crowd. Add intense magenta and blue radial light rays and a central white lens flare.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Apply a large, white, dry-brush script title in the lower center. Add a small pink star above it. Place a single line of wide-tracked, white, geometric sans-serif text at the very bottom.

verificationChecks: Is the double exposure effect clear?
Are the light rays radial and centered?
Does the script text have a visible brush texture?
Is the color palette strictly magenta, blue, and black?

adjustableVariables: Balance between magenta and blue hues
mustRedesign: Ensure the star icon is a generic shape
Do not replicate the exact facial features of the subject

avoid: Hard edges between the two exposures

postGenerationChecks: Check for smooth gradients in the light flares
Verify the brush texture is visible on the main title
Ensure the metadata text is perfectly centered and legible
Confirm the double exposure doesn't obscure the central performer
recipe.reuseFormula: Double Exposure + Radial Neon Flare + Brush Script Overlay
